description: Labelled customer messages for the extraction smoke check (architecture 7.4). Synthetic: no real customer data.

cases.text: My checkout fails with an error 500 when I tap Pay now on the cart page.
I keep getting sent back to the login page after I enter my password. It started this morning.
The app crashes every time I try to upload a photo bigger than about 10 MB.
Search returns nothing even for products I can see on the home page.
Password reset emails take over twenty minutes to arrive, so the link has expired.
The whole site is down for me and my team, we only see a blank white page.
All the orders I placed last week have disappeared from my account history.
In dark mode the text on the invoice page is grey on dark grey and I cannot read it.
On my phone the menu icon sits on top of the logo and covers it.
There is a spelling mistake on the pricing page, the third plan says Enterprize.
The buttons on the settings screen are not lined up and one is cut off at the edge.
I was charged twice for my subscription this month and I would like one of the payments refunded.
My invoice shows the enterprise plan but we only ever signed up for the basic one.
I paid yesterday but I never received a receipt or an invoice by email.
Where can I find the option to export all my past orders as a spreadsheet?
How do I add a colleague to our account so they can see the reports?
Is there a limit on how many projects I can create on my plan?
It would be great if you supported single sign-on with our company identity provider.
Please add a scheduled export that sends the weekly report to my inbox automatically.
We need an API endpoint to fetch invoices, doing it by hand does not scale for us.
Something feels off with the app lately but I cannot say exactly what.
What is the weather going to be like in Paris this weekend?
Can you tell me a joke about programmers?
Do you have a good recipe for chocolate chip cookies?
Thanks a lot, that fixed it, have a great day!
Hello there, good morning!
Paying does not work, I press Pay now at checkout and I just get a server error 500.
My card was billed two times for the same month of my subscription, please refund the extra charge.
The invoice page is unreadable in dark mode, the grey text blends into the background.
I enter the right password and the app just takes me back to the sign in page again and again.
